I believe this Presbytery made a clear error of judgment by essentially making a preemptive decision on a matter that was not yet before them. There was no BCO 20-9 motion.

It was as if the men at one Presbytery meeting were trying to speak for the men at a future meeting. So the motion to adopt Recommendation 5 was procedurally out-of-order. The men at one meeting cannot bind men at a future meeting regarding a future question (

artifacts.synopsis: Great Lakes Presbytery erred in approving Recommendation 5 of its Judicial Commission's report, which preemptively stated that Presbytery would not recommend or transfer TE Gonzales if he declined to demit or step away from ministry, because such action exceeded Presbytery's authority apart from censure after due judicial process.
